entities.name: Dmitry Mikhailovich Golitsyn the Elder
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prince Dmitry Mikhailovich Golitsyn was a Russian aristocrat of the Golitsyn family. A cousin of Prince Vasily Vasilyevich Golitsyn, he was noted for his attempt to turn the Russian Empire into a constitutional monarchy.
